criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Each frame its own picture; LOOK V2 met; 1, 5, 7, 9 pass the showstopper test. Held down by 4 (wall band, flat folders, moire), 6 (slot mid frame, pill floats), 3 (front on grille), 8 (no parents).

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Spine and order hold, both devices work; 8 bus yellow and 6 cobalt blur the spine.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces, nearly kept, attribution on every share; single advocacy source; slide 6 headline drops attribution; slide 9 'its 42' unclear. No hard fail.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: One clear finding; Texas 2036 never introduced and reads as a year on 7; no body named to issue guidance; no place; ask lacks a route.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 4 turns, close hands over a step; four counting frames sag; 3 and 8 movable.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean; machinery shows ('drawn to illustrate' six times, 'reported' everywhere).

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh topic and palette; fourth unit-count spine in four days.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: 40 percent flat wall band, folders flat quads, moire, camera above rows.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera at the first row so rows run to the type; folders with thickness in contact; fix screen filtering.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Slot mid frame with a muddy shadow, pill floats below, shelf leg a black slab.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Slot nearest and sharp, bare oak lit, pill in the slot.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Near orthographic front view reads as a lit grille.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Rake 30 degrees and swing the doors visibly out.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: No person, flat pink windows, yellow competes with amber.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Parents at the covered walk, bus secondary, hue away from the accent.
